resolved.title: 访问文件
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Accessing Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

An external file can be opened, read from, and written to in a C program. For these operations, C includes the [b]FILE[/b] type for defining a file stream. The [b]file stream[/b] keeps track of where reading and writing last occurred.

The [b]stdio.h[/b] library includes file handling functions:
[b]FILE[/b]  Typedef for defining a file pointer.

[b]fopen(filename, mode)[/b] Returns a FILE pointer to file [i]filename[/i] which is opened using [i]mode[/i]. If a file cannot be opened, NULL is returned.
Mode options are:
[b] [/b]-[b] r[/b] open for reading (file must exist)
[b] [/b]-[b] w[/b] open for writing (file need not exist)
 - [b]a[/b] open for append (file need not exist)
 - [b]r+[/b] open for reading and writing from beginning
 - [b]w+[/b] open for reading and writing, overwriting file
 - [b]a+[/b] open for reading and writing, appending to file

[b]fclose(fp)[/b] Closes file opened with FILE fp, returning 0 if close was successful. [b]EOF[/b] (end of file) is returned if there is an error in closing.

The following program opens a file for writing and then closes it:[code format="c" codeId="2169"]#include <stdio.h>

int main() {  
  [b]FILE *fptr;[/b]
  
  fptr = [b]fopen("myfile.txt", "w");[/b]
  if (fptr == NULL) {
    printf("Error opening file.");
    return -1;
  }
[b]  fclose(fptr);[/b]
  return 0;
} [/code]
When a string literal is used to specify a filename, the escape sequence \\ indicates a single backslash. In this program, if there is an error when opening the file, a [b]-1[/b] error code is returned to the system. Error handling is explained in a future lesson. 
[note]Closing a file when you are done using it is a good programming practice.[/note]

content.text:
文件可以在C语言程序中被打开、读取和写入。对于这些操作，C语言包括**FILE**文件类型，用于定义一个文件流。**文件流**记录了最后一次读和写的位置。

**stdio.h**库包括文件处理函数。
**FILE**类型定义了一个文件指针。

**fopen(filename, mode)** 返回一个指向文件`filename`的`FILE`指针，该文件使用`mode`模式打开。如果一个文件不能被打开，则返回NULL。

模式`mode`有以下几项：

- **-r**: 为读取而打开（文件必须存在）。
- **-w**: 为写而打开（文件不必存在）。
- **a**: 打开用于追加（文件不需要存在）。
- **r+**: 为读和写从头开始打开
- **w+**: 为读写打开，覆盖文件
- **a+**: 为读写打开，追加到文件上

**fclose(fp)** 关闭用打开的文件，如果关闭成功则返回0。如果关闭时有错误，则返回**EOF**（文件结束）。

An external file can be opened, read from, and written to in a C program. For these operations, C includes the FILE type for defining a file stream. The file stream keeps track of where reading and writing last occurred.

The stdio.h library includes file handling functions: FILE Typedef for defining a file pointer.

fopen(filename, mode) Returns a FILE pointer to file filename which is opened using mode. If a file cannot be opened, NULL is returned. Mode options are: ** - r** open for reading (file must exist) ** - w** open for writing (file need not exist)

  • a open for append (file need not exist)
  • r+ open for reading and writing from beginning
  • w+ open for reading and writing, overwriting file
  • a+ open for reading and writing, appending to file

fclose(fp) Closes file opened with FILE fp, returning 0 if close was successful. EOF (end of file) is returned if there is an error in closing.

stdio.h库包括文件处理函数。 FILE类型定义了一个文件指针。

fopen(filename, mode) 返回一个指向文件filename的FILE指针，该文件使用mode打开。如果一个文件不能被打开，则返回NULL。 模式选项是。 ** - r** 为读取而打开（文件必须存在）。 ** - w** 为写而打开（文件不必存在）。

  • a 打开用于追加（文件不需要存在）。
  • r+ 为读和写从头开始打开
  • w+ 为读写打开，覆盖文件
  • a+ 为读写打开，附加到文件上

fclose(fp) 关闭用FILE fp打开的文件，如果关闭成功则返回0。如果关闭时有错误，则返回EOF（文件结束）。

resolved.title: 读取文件

content.text:
**stdio.h**库还包括用于从打开的文件读取的函数。

一个文件可以一次读取一个字符，也可以将整个字符串读入字符缓冲区，该缓冲区通常是用于临时存储的`char`数组。

- `getc(fp)` 返回fp指向的文件中的下一个字符。如果已到达文件末尾，则返回EOF。

- `fgets(buff, n, fp)` fgets函数功能为从指定的流中读取数据，每次读取一行。其原型为：`char *fgets(char *str, int n, FILE *stream);`从指定的流 `stream` 读取一行，并把它存储在 `str` 所指向的字符串内。当读取到第 `(n-1)` 个字符时，或者读取到换行符时，或者到达文件末尾时，它会停止，具体视情况而定。

- `fscanf(fp, conversion_specifiers, vars)` 从fp指向的文件中读取字符，并使用`conversion_specifiers`将输入分配给变量指针`vars`列表。与`scanf`一样，遇到空格或换行符时，`fscanf`会停止读取字符串。


下面的程序演示了从一个文件中读取数据:
content.text_html:
The stdio.h library also includes functions for reading from an open file. A file can be read one character at a time or an entire string can be read into a character buffer, which is typically a char array used for temporary storage.

fgetc(fp) Returns the next character from the file pointed to by fp. If the end of the file has been reached, then EOF is returned.

fgets(buff, n, fp) Reads n-1 characters from the file pointed to by fp and stores the string in buff. A NULL character '\0' is appended as the last character in buff. If fgets encounters a newline character or the end of file before n-1 characters is reached, then only the characters up to that point are stored in buff.

fscanf(fp, conversion_specifiers, vars) Reads characters from the file pointed to by fp and assigns input to a list of variable pointers vars using conversion_specifiers. As with scanf, fscanf stops reading a string when a space or newline is encountered.

The following program demonstrates reading from a file:

stdio.h库还包括从开放文件中读取的函数。一个文件可以一次读一个字符，也可以把整个字符串读到一个字符**缓冲区，这通常是一个用于临时存储的char数组。

**fgetc(fp)**返回fp所指向的文件中的下一个字符。如果已经到达了文件的末尾，则返回EOF。

**fgets(buff, n, fp)**从fp所指向的文件中读取n-1个字符，并将字符串存入buff中。一个NULL字符'\0'被附加在buff的最后一个字符上。如果fgets在达到n-1个字符之前遇到一个换行符或文件的末尾，那么只有到该点的字符被存储在buff中。

**fscanf(fp, conversion_specifiers, vars)**从fp所指向的文件中读取字符，并使用conversion_specifiers将输入分配给变量指针vars列表。与scanf一样，fscanf在遇到空格或换行时停止读取字符串。

下面的程序演示了从一个文件中读取数据。

content.text:
`fgets()` 函数读取直到换行符。 `fscanf()` 根据转换格式符读取数据。

然后 `while` 循环一次读取一个字符，直到文件结束。
content.text_html:
The gets() function reads up until the newline. fscanf() reads data according to conversion specifiers. And then the while loop reads one character at a time until the end of file. Checking for a problem when opening the file (a NULL pointer) was left out to shorten the example.

**gets()函数一直读到换行。fscanf()**根据转换指定器读取数据。然后，while循环每次读取一个字符，直到文件结束。检查打开文件时的问题（一个NULL指针）被省略了，以缩短例子。

resolved.title: 写入文件

content.text:
**stdio.h**库还包括用于写入文件的函数。写入文件时，必须显式添加换行符`\n`。

- `fputc(char, fp)` 将字符char写入fp指向的文件。

- `fputs(str, fp)` 将字符串str写入fp指向的文件。

- `fprintf(fp, str, vars)` 将字符串str打印到fp指向的文件。 str可以选择包括格式转换符和变量vars列表。

下面的程序演示了向一个文件的写入。
content.text_html:
The stdio.h library also includes functions for writing to a file. When writing to a file, newline characters '\n' must be explicitly added.

fputc(char, fp) Writes character char to the file pointed to by fp.

fputs(str, fp) Writes string str to the file pointed to by fp.

fprintf(fp, str, vars) Prints string str to the file pointed to by fp. str can optionally include format specifiers and a list of variables vars.

The following program demonstrates writing to a file:

stdio.h库也包括向文件写入的函数。写入文件时，必须明确添加换行符'\n'。

fputc(char, fp) 将字符char写到fp所指向的文件。

fputs(str, fp) 将字符串str写到fp指向的文件中。

fprintf(fp, str, vars) 打印字符串str到fp所指向的文件。str可以选择包括格式指定器和变量vars的列表。

下面的程序演示了向一个文件的写入。

The **"w" **argument defines "writing mode" for the **fopen **function.

参数**"w "定义了fopen**函数的 "写入模式"。
